title: Inversion and Emphasis / Inversión da ƙarfi
bridge: A cikin turanci, domin mu yi ƙarfi, muna yin ƙirar kalma ko yin fasaha da 'sí que' ko 'es que', amma a cikin turanci, ƙarfin yin fasaha yana daidai da canza tsarin da ke da 'not only... but also' ko 'so + adjective... that'. Wannan zai iya zama mai ban zama ga masu yaren waje saboda a turanci, canza tsarin ba da yawa ba ne, ko da yake a tambaya ko kasuwanci mai zurfi. Sabon kuskure ne ya yi daidai da canza tsarin ba da yawa ba ne, saboda a turanci, canza tsarin da ke da 'not only', 'never', 'rarely' da sauran, saboda a turanci, canza tsarin ba da yawa ba ne.
rule: Canza tsarin a turanci yana da amfani don yi ƙarfi ko a fasaha mai zurfi. Ya faru a wannan yankuna: 1) Bayan adadun adadin da ke da 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'no sooner', 'not only', 'not until', 'little', 'in no way'. A wannan yanku, ana canza taimako (do/does/did, have/has, will, etc.) da ke da gabansa, kuma yana da karshe a kan maƙala da ke da 'to'. Misali: 'Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.' 2) Da 'so + adjective/adverb' da 'such + noun' a fagewa na kalmar don nuna sabon abu ko sabon abu, da ke da 'that' (duk da yake 'that' zai iya kashewa): 'So beautiful was the painting that everyone stared.' 3) Don nuna tsari da 'not only... but also', 'only after', 'only if', etc. 4) A tsarin fasaha mai zurfi, ana canza maƙala da ke da 'if' da ke da 'had' ko 'should'. 5) Da 'here' da 'there' bayan kalma da ke da 'intransitive verb' da ke da 'noun' a matsayin maƙala, ba da ke da 'pronoun'. 6) A fasaha mai zurfi da ke da 'may'. Mahimmanci: a turanci ba a yi canza tsarin a kalmomin da ke da 'declarative' ba (da yawa a turanci a tambaya ko fasaha mai zurfi), kuma ba zai iya zama mai ban zama da fasaha mai zurfi. Kuna iya amfani da canza tsarin da ke da 'adverb' da ke da 'negative' da ke da 'auxiliary', ko da yake a kalmomin da ke da 'simple present' da ke da 'no auxiliary'.

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered such a challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Ba zan ga wani matsala mai wahala da yawa ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntərd sʌtʃ ə ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Not only did she lose her job, but she also had to relocate.
concept_examples.translation: Ba kawai ya rasa aikinsa, amma kuma ya kama ya koma wani gida.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː luːz hɜː dʒɒb bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ hæd tə ˌriːləʊˈkeɪt/

concept_examples.text: So intense was the heat that the roads began to melt.
concept_examples.translation: Da yawa ne wannan zafi, saboda hanyoyi suka fara rasa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /səʊ ɪnˈtens wɒz ðə hiːt ðæt ðə rəʊdz bɪˈɡæn tə melt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the war did the country experience true reconstruction.
concept_examples.translation: Kwarai bayan warshe, an sami sabon haske.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈəʊnli ˈæftə ðə wɔː dɪd ðə ˈkʌntri ɪkˈspɪəriəns truː ˌriːkənˈstrʌkʃən/

common_error.wrong: Not only he has a beautiful voice, but also he sings well.
common_error.correct: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.correct_alt: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.explanation: An yi kuskure saboda a turanci muna yi 'Not only he arrived late' saboda ba a canza taimako da maƙala. Amma a turanci, bayan 'not only', da ke da 'inversion', ana canza taimako da maƙala. Kuna iya amfani da 'does' a present simple, amma maƙala 'have' ya zama a matsayin maƙala. Saboda haka, a kan 'not only', 'never', 'rarely' da sauran, tsarin ne: taimako + maƙala + maƙala mai zurfi.

levels.label: Negative Adverbial Inversion
levels.translation: Canza tsarin da ke da 'negative adverbs'

examples.original: Never have I seen such a dedicated team.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə ˈdɛdɪkeɪtɪd tiːm/
examples.translation: Ba zan gan shi ba a cikin wata lokaci.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'never' a fagewa da ke da canza taimako da 'have' da 'I'. A turanci, ba a canza taimako ba, muna yi 'Nunca he visto'.

examples.original: Rarely do we find such an honest politician.
examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː faɪnd sʌtʃ ən ˈɒnɪst ˌpɒlɪˈtɪʃən/
examples.translation: Ba zan sami wani matsayi mai zurfi ba.
examples.note: Da ke da 'rarely', muna yi amfani da 'do' a present simple, da ke da 'find' ya zama a matsayin maƙala.

examples.original: Hardly had we left the house when it started to rain.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli hæd wiː lɛft ðə haʊs wɛn ɪt ˈstɑːtɪd tə reɪn/
examples.translation: Da yake muna fita daga gida, ya fara ruwa.
examples.note: Tsarin 'hardly... when' yana nuna cewa wani abu ya faru bayan wani abu. Muna yi amfani da 'past perfect' da ke da canza taimako.

levels.label: Inversion with 'So' and 'Such'
levels.translation: Canza tsarin da ke da 'so' da 'such'

examples.original: So tired was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈtaɪəd wɒz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Da yawa ne ta yi ta idan ta barci a nan da nan.
examples.note: Tsarin 'so + adjective + was/were + subject + that' yana da amfani don nuna ƙarfi mai zurfi. A turanci, muna yi 'tan... that' ba da canza taimako ba.

examples.original: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wɒz ðə nɔɪz ðæt ˈnəʊbədi kʊd sliːp/
examples.translation: Wannan mugu ne ya ke da kama da kowa ba zai iya barci ba.
examples.note: Muna yi amfani da 'such' bayan maƙala don nuna ƙarfi. A wannan, 'such' ya zama a matsayin adjective, da ke da 'was' da ke da gabansa.

examples.original: So quickly did she finish that everyone was amazed.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈkwɪkli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðæt ˈɛvrɪwʌn wɒz əˈmeɪzd/
examples.translation: Da sauri ya kare ta, saboda haka dukkan mutane sun yi mamaki.
examples.note: Da yake muna yi amfani da adverb ('quickly') a matsayin adjective, muna buƙatar taimako 'did' da ke da maƙala mai zurfi.

levels.label: Conditional Inversion and Formal Structures
levels.translation: Canza tsarin da ke da 'conditional' da fasaha masu zurfi

examples.original: Had I known about the delay, I would have left earlier.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ nəʊn əˈbaʊt ðə dɪˈleɪ aɪ wʊd hæv lɛft ˈɜːliə/
examples.translation: Idan zan san cewa an tsaya, zan fita da yaushe.
examples.note: A fasaha masu zurfi, muna iya kashewa 'if' da ke da 'had'. Ya dace da 'If I had known...'.

examples.original: Should you need any assistance, do not hesitate to call us.
examples.phonetic: /ʃʊd juː niːd ˈɛni əˈsɪstəns duː nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə kɔːl ʌs/
examples.translation: Idan zan buƙatar wata taimako, kuna iya kiranta.
examples.note: Muna yi amfani da canza taimako da 'should' a matsayin fasaha mai zurfi. A turanci, muna yi 'si necesitara'.

examples.original: No sooner had the concert started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈkɒnsət ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Da yake muna fara wasanni, ya fara tsarin.
examples.note: 'No sooner... than' yana nuna cewa wani abu ya faru bayan wani abu, da ke da canza taimako a past perfect.

examples.original: Were the government to propose such a law, it would be highly controversial.
examples.phonetic: /wɜː ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt tə prəˈpəʊz sʌtʃ ə lɔː ɪt wʊd biː ˈhaɪli ˌkɒntrəˈvɜːʃəl/
examples.translation: Idan gwamnati ta yi wannan tsarin, zai zama mai zurfi.
examples.note: Tsarin fasaha mai zurfi da ke da 'were + subject + to + infinitive' a matsayin fasaha mai zurfi.

translations.ha: Sintaxis mai zurfi da fasaha masu zurfi

title: Register and Style: Formal, Informal, and Neutral / Tsarin da Tsarin: Daɗewa, Baƙin ciki da Dole-sa-sa
bridge: A cikin yare na Turanci, tsarin da tsarin yana nuna da lafazai, fasaha, da wasanni da wasanni. Wata matsala ce wata ke da yawa a cikin wasu yaren Turanci, da yawa a cikin wasu yaren Turanci, da yawa a cikin wasu yaren Turanci, da yawa a cikin wasu yaren Turanci. Misali, 'I am writing to you in order to request...' yana da tsarin da tsarin, amma 'I'm writing to ask...' yana da tsarin da tsarin a cikin fasaha masu zaman kansu. Muna buƙatar gane fasaha da yawa a cikin fasaha da yawa a cikin fasaha.
rule: A cikin Turanci C1, tsarin da tsarin yana nuna a cikin yankuna da yankuna: fasaha (misali, 'get' da 'obtain', 'show' da 'demonstrate'), fasaha (yadda ake yin wasanni, wasanni, wasanni), da fasaha (fasaha, fasaha, fasaha). Tsarin da tsarin yana da fasaha masu zaman kansu, fasaha masu zaman kansu, fasaha masu zaman kansu. Tsarin da tsarin yana da fasaha masu zaman kansu, fasaha masu zaman kansu, fasaha masu zaman kansu. Tsarin da tsarin yana da fasaha masu zaman kansu, fasaha masu zaman kansu, fasaha masu zaman kansu.

concept_examples.text: I would be grateful if you could provide me with further details.
concept_examples.translation: Ina fatan cewa za ka iya ba ni bayanai masu zurfi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd biː ˈɡreɪtfʊl ɪf juː kʊd prəˈvaɪd miː wɪð ˈfɜːðər ˈdiːteɪlz/

concept_examples.text: Could you send me the report by Friday?
concept_examples.translation: Zan iya aika mana rahoton zuwa ranar Jumma'a?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː sɛnd miː ðə rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: No worries, I'll get back to you later.
concept_examples.translation: Bari zan amsa ka da da da da da.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈwʌriz aɪl ɡɛt bæk tə juː ˈleɪtər/

common_error.wrong: I am writing this in order to ask you for a favor, because I need to know if you can help me with the presentation.
common_error.correct: I'm writing to ask a favor – could you help me with the presentation?
common_error.correct_alt: I'm writing to ask you a favor: would you be able to help me with the presentation?
common_error.explanation: Matsaloli yana saboda mutane da yaren Turanci suke da yawa a cikin fasaha. Misali, suka fara da fasaha mai tsarin ('I am writing this in order to ask') sannan suka canza zuwa fasaha mai daɗe-sa-sa ('because I need to know'). A cikin Turanci, yana da muhimmanci a matsakaici da fasaha mai tsarin ko mai daɗe-sa-sa. Don haka, a matsakaici da fasaha mai tsarin ko mai daɗe-sa-sa, a matsakaici da fasaha mai tsarin ko mai daɗe-sa-sa.

examples.original: The company has decided to implement a new policy.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəni hæz dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɪmplɪmɛnt ə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.translation: Kasuwanci ya yi shawarar aiki sabuwar tsarin aiki.
examples.note: Uso de la voz pasiva para dar énfasis al hecho y no al agente. Es común en contextos formales.

examples.original: We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
examples.phonetic: /wiː rɪˈɡrɛt tʊ ɪnˈfɔːm juː ðæt jɔːr ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən hæz biːn ˌʌnsəkˈsɛsfəl/
examples.translation: Lamentamos informarle de que su solicitud no ha tenido éxito.
examples.note: Yin amfani da fasaha mai tsarin don nuna sabon abu ne da ba a cikin fasaha mai tsarin ba.

examples.original: Would you be so kind as to sign the attached document?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː səʊ kaɪnd æz tə saɪn ði əˈtætʃt ˈdɒkjʊmənt/
examples.translation: Muna jin tsoro a koyaushe mu ba da fatan kuwa ba.
examples.note: Estructura indirecta de cortesía. En español usamos 'usted', mientras que aquí se usa 'would you be so kind' como marcador de formalidad.

examples.original: Please send me the updated version of the file.
examples.phonetic: /pliːz sɛnd miː ði ˌʌpˈdeɪtɪd ˈvɜːʃən əv ðə faɪl/
examples.translation: Da fatan za a aika mana fasalin sabon da ya sabis.
examples.note: Neutro: claro y directo, pero no demasiado coloquial. Sin contracciones ni lenguaje técnico.

examples.original: I'll forward you the details as soon as I get them.
examples.phonetic: /aɪl ˈfɔːwərd juː ðə ˈdiːteɪlz æz suːn æz aɪ ɡɛt ðɛm/
examples.translation: Te reenvío los detalles en cuanto los reciba.
examples.note: Tsarin mai daɗe-sa-sa ne mai daɗe-sa-sa da ba a cikin fasaha mai tsarin ba.

examples.original: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ hæz biːn pəʊstˈpəʊnd ənˈtɪl nɛkst wiːk/
examples.translation: Zan sake aiko mana bayanai da yaushe zan samu su.
examples.note: Uso de 'postponed' (más formal que 'put off') pero con pasiva simple, común en registros neutros.

examples.original: Wanna grab a coffee later?
examples.phonetic: /ˈwɒnə ɡræb ə ˈkɒfi ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: Kun ji wata sabon abu mai kyau ba?
examples.note: Uso de 'wanna' (forma coloquial de 'want to') y 'grab' (agarrar) en lugar de 'have'. Muy informal.

examples.original: I can't make it to the party tonight, sorry!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ kɑːnt meɪk ɪt tə ðə ˈpɑːti təˈnaɪt ˈsɒri/
examples.translation: No puedo ir a la fiesta esta noche, ¡lo siento!
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'wanna' (fasaha mai daɗe-sa-sa da 'want to') da 'grab' (nema) a cikin fasaha mai daɗe-sa-sa.

examples.original: That's a really cool idea, let's do that!
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈrɪəli kuːl aɪˈdɪə lɛts duː ðæt/
examples.translation: Ba zan iya zo wata filin wannan dare ba, saboda zan yi!
examples.note: Adjetivo coloquial 'cool' en lugar de 'excellent' o 'good'. Exclamación y contracciones refuerzan el tono.

title: Advanced Inversion and Fronting / Inversión da fasaha da fasaha
bridge: A cikin turanci, fasaha (sanya tambaya mai yuwuwar taimaka wa a gabansa da na iya amfani da ita domin nuna ƙarfi ko yin ra’ayin na fasaha. A cikin Hausa, muna samun ra’ayin da yake da fasaha ta hanyar ƙarancen sa da sauran kalmomi ba tare da canza fasaha ba. Misali, 'Rarely have I seen such beauty' a Hausa zai zama 'Ba da yaushe na gan shi wannan haske ba', ba tare da fasaha. Tsoro ne mai yawa saboda a Hausa fasaha ta yiwa a matsayin tambaya kawai, while a turanci ta iya faruwa a cikin bayanai da adadin wasu adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ban sha’awa. Yi tsoro: ba zaka iya yin fasaha a kowane adadin da ke fitarwa, kawai a cikin adadin da ke da wannan iyaka.
rule: Fasaha a turanci yana faruwa yayin da wasu abubuwa (adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ban sha’awa, adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ƙarfi, ko adadin da ke da ma’ana mai yaushe da ma’ana mai ban sha’awa) suka zama a fitarwa na cikin jumla. A wannan yanayi, tambaya mai yuwuwar (ko tambaya mai 'be') ya zama a gabansa da na iya a gabansa da na iya a gabansa da na iya a gabansa da na iya. Tsarin da ke da yawa sun hada da: 1) Adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ban sha’awa: 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'barely', 'no sooner' - misali: 'Never have I seen such a mess'. 2) Adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ƙarfi: 'not only...but also', 'only after', 'only by', 'only when' - misali: 'Only after the war did they return'. 3) Adadin da ke da ma’ana mai yaushe da 'so' ko 'such' - misali: 'So beautiful was the sunset that we stopped'. 4) Da 'not until' ko 'not since' - misali: 'Not until midnight did the party end'. 5) Da 'in no way', 'on no account', 'under no circumstances'. Yi tunanin da ba wani tambaya mai yuwuwa ba, yi amfani da 'do/does/did' domin fasaha a yanzu da baya da yaushe. Wannan fasaha ta yiwa da fasaha na fasaha; a cikin magana mai yawa ba da fasaha ba, amma ta iya faruwa a cikin magana mai ƙarfi. Da fasaha mai fasaha, wanda ba a iya yin fasaha ba, ko adadin ko komai ya zama a fitarwa domin nuna ƙarfi, sanya kalmomin da ke da fasaha a fitarwa, kamar 'That book I would never read' (sannan 'I would never read that book').

concept_examples.text: Never have I seen such a magnificent sunset.
concept_examples.translation: Ba da yaushe na gan wata haske mai girma da yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt ˈsʌnsɛt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the meeting did she realize her mistake.
concept_examples.translation: Kawai bayan da ake cikin taron ne ya gane zai zama matsala.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ dɪd ʃiː ˈriːəlaɪz hɜːr mɪˈsteɪk/

concept_examples.text: Not only did he finish the race, but he also broke the record.
concept_examples.translation: Ba kawai ya kare yatsa ba, amma ya rabu da sabon rekord.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈoʊnli dɪd hiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə reɪs bʌt hiː ˈɔːlsoʊ broʊk ðə ˈrɛkərd/

concept_examples.text: Under no circumstances should you open that door.
concept_examples.translation: Ba a wata hanyar da za a buɗe wannan gida ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndər noʊ ˈsɜːrkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈoʊpən ðæt dɔːr/

common_error.wrong: Rarely I have seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct: Rarely have I seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct_alt: I have rarely seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.explanation: Yin zargi ne saboda a Hausa ba muna yin fasaha a cikin bayanai da adadin da ke fitarwa. Da bayyana 'Rara vez he visto' a turanci, ba a yin fasaha ba. Yi tunanin: yayin da adadin mai ban sha’awa ko adadin mai yaushe da ma’ana mai ban sha’awa ya zama a fitarwa a cikin jumla, ya kamata ka yi fasaha da tambaya mai yuwuwa da na iya a gabansa da na iya. Idan ka son yin wannan ba tare da fasaha ba, za ka iya sanya adadin a cikin fasaha da ba a iya fasaha ba, saboda ba zai faru fasaha ba.

levels.label: Negative Adverbials
levels.translation: Adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ban sha’awa

examples.original: Never had she felt so alone.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæd ʃiː fɛlt soʊ əˈloʊn/
examples.translation: Ba da yaushe ba ya ji da yawa ko da yake da kwanaki.
examples.note: Yin amfani da 'never' a fitarwa da cikin yaushe mai yawa, da fasaha da 'had' da na iya.

examples.original: Rarely do we see such dedication.
examples.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdɛdɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Ba da yaushe muna gan wata haske mai girma da yawa.
examples.note: Da yaushe mai fasaha, ya kamata a yi amfani da 'do' a matsayin tambaya mai yuwuwa domin fasaha.

examples.original: Hardly had the play started when the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːrdli hæd ðə pleɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd wɛn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːrm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Kawai bayan da ake cikin aiki ne ya fara yayin da alarama ta motsi ta sanyi.
examples.note: Tsarin 'hardly...when' ya bukata fasaha a cikin fasaha da yaushe, ko da yaushe mai yawa.

levels.label: Restrictive Expressions
levels.translation: Adadin da ke da ma’ana mai ƙarfi

examples.original: Only by working hard can you achieve your goals.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli baɪ ˈwɜːrkɪŋ hɑːrd kæn juː əˈtʃiːv jɔːr ɡoʊlz/
examples.translation: Kawai da ake cikin aiki mai yawa zaka iya samun abu na nufi.
examples.note: Da 'only by' + gerund, fasaha ta faruwa a cikin jumla mai yawa.

examples.original: Not until midnight did the storm subside.
examples.phonetic: /nɒt ənˈtɪl ˈmɪdnaɪt dɪd ðə stɔːrm səbˈsaɪd/
examples.translation: Ba har zuwa tsawon rana ba ne ya rage yunwa.
examples.note: Da 'not until', fasaha ta faruwa a cikin jumla mai yawa, ba a cikin jumla mai yaushe ba.

examples.original: Only when the last tree is cut down will we realize its importance.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn ðə lɑːst triː ɪz kʌt daʊn wɪl wiː ˈriːəlaɪz ɪts ɪmˈpɔːrtəns/
examples.translation: Kawai da ake cikin yin wata gajiya, za mu gane ma’ana ta.
examples.note: Duba cewa fasaha ta faruwa a cikin jumla mai yawa, ba a cikin jumla mai yaushe da 'when' ba.

examples.original: So exhausted was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /soʊ ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd wʌz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Tunda ya yi da yawa, sai ya bar da shi a daidai.
examples.note: Fasaha da 'so + adjective' a fitarwa ke nuna ƙarfi mai ban sha’awa.

examples.original: Such was the chaos that no one could hear the announcement.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wʌz ðə ˈkeɪɒs ðæt noʊ wʌn kʊd hɪər ði əˈnaʊnsmənt/
examples.translation: Wannan matsala ta yi da yawa, ba wani ya iya jin bayanin ba.
examples.note: 'Such' + verb + noun; fasaha ta faruwa da tambaya mai 'be'.

examples.original: That film I would never watch again.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt fɪlm aɪ wʊd ˈnɛvər wɒtʃ əˈɡɛn/
examples.translation: Wannan film ba zan iya gan shi komai ba.
examples.note: Fasaha mai fasaha: adadin ya zama a fitarwa domin nuna ƙarfi, amma fasaha ta na iya.
